title: Trees in Our Town
text:
Trees are very important for our planet. They give us clean air and shade. Many birds build nests in trees. In the forest, there are many animals.

Some people plant new trees in the park. They water the trees every week. The trees grow big and tall after some years. Then the park is green and nice.

questions.text: How often do people water the trees?
What can we say about the forest?
options: It is a good home for many animals

questions.text: What is probably true about the park after some years?
options: It is full of trees and green
It is always covered in snow

vocabulary.definition: a large area with many trees
a home that birds build for their eggs
a dark, cool place where the sun does not reach

paragraph_translations: Drzewa są bardzo ważne dla naszej planety. Dają nam czyste powietrze i cień. Wiele ptaków buduje gniazda na drzewach. W lesie mieszka wiele zwierząt.
Niektórzy ludzie sadzą nowe drzewa w parku. Podlewają drzewa co tydzień. Drzewa rosną duże i wysokie po kilku latach. Wtedy park jest zielony i ładny.
